comment: Manual read at https://flagaudio.com/vcv/stems.html. The transport buttons carry icons and no lettering; the maker's param names Stop, Play From Start, Play, Pause and Reset were used, and the panel positions confirm the left-to-right order. The manual gives the meter colours and the resampling behaviour but does not distinguish Stop from Pause, so neither line claims what happens to the play position. The time display and the track display are drawn in code and have no clickable control.
